title: ExerciseBatchMeta
description: Machine-readable header that a generated exercise batch may declare inside a <script type="application/json" id="cm-exercise-meta"> block. It is OPTIONAL: exam-hub.js degrades gracefully when a batch was generated before this contract existed. When present it lets the hub render accurate question counts, durations and difficulty without parsing the batch's own DOM.

supportsScoreBridge.description: Whether the batch will emit CYBERMASTERY_SCORE itself. When false the hub relies on its injected bridge.

resultsSelector.description: CSS selector the bridge can watch for to detect the results screen, e.g. '#results'.
